title: Real analytic solutions to the divergence equation
summary: In this paper, we develop a differential-topological method to yield explicit real analytic solutions $v$ to the divergence equation $div_{\mathbb{R}^n} v = f$ on any annali $A(R_1 ,R_2) = \{ x \in \mathbb{R}^n : R_1 < |x| < R_2\}$, with $n \geq 2$, and $0 < R_1 < R_2 < \infty$. The prescribed source term $f$ is supposed to be real analytic on $\overline{A(R_1 , R_2)} = \{ x \in \mathbb{R}^n : R_1 \leq |x| \leq R_2\}$ satisfying the zero integral condition on $A(R_1, R_2)$.
